description: Source code for managing telemetry event markers, including data structures, mutexes, and functions for adding, retrieving, and managing event markers and component lists in a telemetry system.

methods.name: freeT2Marker
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a T2Marker and its associated data.

methods.name: freeT2ComponentList
methods.description: Frees memory for component list elements.

methods.name: initT2MarkerComponentMap
methods.description: Initializes mutexes and data structures for marker-component mapping.

methods.name: clearT2MarkerComponentMap
methods.description: Clears and reinitializes the marker-component map and component list.

methods.name: destroyT2MarkerComponentMap
methods.description: Destroys the marker-component map and associated mutex.

methods.name: updateEventMap
methods.description: Adds or updates a marker in the event map.

methods.name: updateComponentList
methods.description: Adds a component name to the component list if not already present.

methods.name: addT2EventMarker
methods.description: Creates or updates a T2Marker for a given marker name, component, and profile.

methods.name: getComponentsWithEventMarkers
methods.description: Retrieves the list of components with event markers.

methods.name: getComponentMarkerList
methods.description: Populates a list of markers associated with a component.

methods.name: getMarkerProfileList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of profiles associated with a marker.

methods.name: createComponentDataElements
methods.description: Creates data elements for each component in the component list.
